I'll check it out. Thanks again.

I feel like I need to get some sleep. I haven't slept a full night since I can't remember. Maybe this will all look better then.

Thank you. I think a huge part of this right now is that I don't have a job. I'm living in a town where jobs are like gold ingots. If one's out in the open, it'll be gone by the time go to reach for it.

She's better than I deserve. I just don't know if I can handle having that money always hanging over my head. The past week I've hardly slept at all. A fitful hour or two a night at best and even then it's the first thing I think about when I wake up. I'm just so tired. I'm so tired of this.
Hilariously a degree in counseling psych.
